owner: @rus/combat-health + @rus/turn; approvals required from independent game-data approver

normative_rule.attack: d20 + floor((attribute_value - 10) / 2) + skill_bonus + state_modifier + equipment_modifier + circumstance_modifier

typed_inputs: source-pinned actor attribute and combat skill
source-pinned target defense and current position

owner_request_binding.actor_ref: current saved intent actor_ref, revalidated against the acting participant before request construction
owner_request_binding.target_ref: current target selected from owner-pinned combat preconditions and revalidated before request construction

inputs.required_binding: same current actor_ref and validated complete source-pinned snapshot
same actor_ref and approved skill source
same actor_ref; unknown is a typed gap

inputs.source: current actor held-item capability owner readback
inputs.required_binding: same actor_ref and item instance refs
same check event and actor/target refs

owner_request_binding.code_owned_rng: one owner-produced RNG result; model supplies no roll or modifier
owner_request_binding.fail_closed: missing, stale, ambiguous, cross-actor or cross-target source binding blocks this step and preserves its typed gap

harm.zero_quality_policy: no ordinary body harm; only a separately supported dangerous circumstance can alter this
harm.unsupported_factors_policy: do not default unknown vulnerability or protection to zero

derived_normalization.scope: implementation behavior used as a separate candidate normalization; it is not attributed verbatim to combat_system.md
derived_normalization.rationale: the health-loss table is defined for nonnegative integer damage scores; preserve the raw norm result and clamp only at the derived normalization boundary

health_transition.at_zero: incapacitated; death is not inferred or emitted by this package
health_transition.missing_or_unreadable_body: if no persisted row exists and approved source inputs/profile are available, initialize by owner rule; a failed/unavailable readback is a typed gap for this actor, never an absence signal and never a health default
health_transition.authority_status: active_domain_norm plus CR #224 scope; v17 body applicability/write handoff pending

body_initialization.rule: if no persisted party_actor_body_states row exists, deterministically initialize this NPC on the first atomic P16 combat commit from approved actor_base_attributes_v1 plus identity under an approved body-state mapping; missing required inputs/profile are a typed gap for this NPC only
body_initialization.authoritative_readback: persisted body row takes precedence and is rechecked before each later step; read failure does not trigger initialization
body_initialization.forbidden_fallback: Never substitute an invented or unapproved value, including candidate health=100, and never load a scenario profile. The D71 profile above is only eligible after body-state owner and independent D67 approval.
body_initialization.approval: candidate mapping proposal is not approved; exact runtime initialization stays fail-closed until body-state owner and D67 approval

actor_attributes.authority_status: v17 production readback confirms actor profile activation for new production parties only; this does not approve body metric mapping

identity.required: versioned actor identity snapshot plus stable ref

calibration.rationale: upper ordinary starting-health proposal anchored by analogy to the scoped first-playable body_profile; not an injury-free historical claim and not a runtime fallback

at endurance 10, proposal 80 is anchored by analogy to the scoped first-playable body_profile; a +2 energy points per endurance point slope is an explicit gameplay hypothesis inspired by endurance semantics in the domain guide, not a source-derived coefficient
ordinary initial satiety proposal anchored by analogy to the scoped first-playable body_profile; exact value is a gameplay calibration, not a generic approved profile

calibration_metadata.analogy_scope: candidate first-playable boatman profile only; its numbers are an analogy and are not loaded as a generic scenario fallback
calibration_metadata.reason: provide a deterministic playable initial body candidate from existing metric vocabulary and one narrowly scoped body-profile anchor; no historical claim or source-derived attribute-to-metric coefficients

fail_closed.when: candidate has not received body-state owner and D67 approval, or source-pinned actor attributes/identity are missing or invalid
fail_closed.effect: typed gap for this NPC only; preserve a persisted body row and never use this unapproved candidate as a fallback

profile_mapping.approval: candidate only; owner @rus/body-state and independent D67 approval required before runtime use
profile_mapping.selection_rule: For an actor with a complete source-pinned actor_base_attributes_v1 snapshot and versioned identity snapshot, select this candidate profile deterministically. Identity ref/version/digest bind the subject; sex, age and appearance do not alter metrics in this proposal. The actor attribute snapshot is validated; endurance is the sole attribute used by the candidate energy rule.

calibration.rationale: flat control to compare the scoped profile analogy without attribute adjustment
lower-start sensitivity arm selected as an explicit game-balance comparison, not as historical evidence

subject_binding.actor_ref: same current NPC actor_ref from saved combat intent and body-state owner operation
subject_binding.actor_attributes: complete validateActorBaseAttributes-accepted actor_base_attributes_v1 snapshot; bind profile_ref, generation.seed_digest, trace and actor_ref to this NPC
subject_binding.identity: versioned identity snapshot with stable identity_ref, schema_version and digest bound to the same NPC actor_ref
subject_binding.derived_initial_state_scope: derived values are output only; keep source actor snapshot, identity snapshot, D71 calibration and resolution trace separate from the approved authored profile

fail_closed_preconditions: owner and D67 approval recorded for this profile version
all six actor base attribute values and full generation/trace/profile_ref validate
identity snapshot version/ref/digest binds to the same actor_ref
no persisted body row exists after authoritative readback; read failure never triggers initialization
owner_initialization_profile_adapter.approval: the test fixture does not approve or emit the candidate profile

initial_state.energy: resolved profile_mapping.output_profile.metrics.energy rule using the bound actor snapshot endurance

target_dto_mapping.emit_when: only when owner and independent D67 approvals are recorded for this exact profile version

owner_initialization_profile_adapter.candidate_emission_policy: null; candidate values cannot be sent to initializeBodyState until approval gate is satisfied

weapon_capability_mapping.scope: one held melee item at most; current accessible grip and condition must be source-pinned; no item may be created by the action text

rules.input: item with an exact owner-supplied combat mechanics capability and current condition snapshot
rules.result: use that exact profile; ordinary light serviceable/damaged map is 1/0 only while its existing capability ref is applicable and independently approved

rules.input: one held action-produced item without exact mechanics, with player-safe physical facts
game-base catalog row without exact mechanics
rules.result: use wp_id/category/kind/material/condition/source refs only to resolve the actual item; separately source-pinned physical-form facts may be passed to D47; do not derive danger from category, military tier, mass, role, frequency, or access; otherwise typed gap

unmapped_catalog_melee_rows.reason: normative example does not resolve the relevant variant or its size/use; ranged/mounted actions are excluded

durations.representation: exact positive rational elapsed minutes, common GameTimestamp; no round clock

calibration.decision_rule: one bounded resolved attack step per six-second gameplay slice, giving ten such slices per game minute; chosen for play pacing and exact sub-minute arithmetic, not derived from historical action measurements
calibration.rationale: bounded play-pacing comparison; one resolved attack step in 5–10 seconds, with 6 seconds as initial proposal; not historical measurement

includes: one attack check and its harm/health resolution
does_not_include: approach, retreat movement, treatment, delayed consequences
per_action_profiles.automatic_defense_timing: time-owner confirmation required whether folded into the attack step

npc_boundary_and_intent_events.rule: a decision/signal projection alone advances no clock; any physical step it starts needs its own approved profile

retreat_movement.reason: no applicable generic movement speed/profile and current integration does not confirm a common rational-time handoff

meaningful_boundary.rule: evaluate at initial combat intent and after an unconsumed material/critical signal changes the NPC's perceived facts, capability, or executable intent; aggregate same-time signals after temporal recheck

decision_context_required: current NPC intent and lifecycle status
unconsumed decision signals with causal refs
NPC body/capability facts known to that NPC
perception snapshot of visible participants, recognized threats, known positions, known exits, hazards and uncertainty
individual goals/fears/obligations/relationships only when source-pinned and applicable
allowlisted operation refs and code-owned feasibility results

surrender_basis: perceived threat and recent material/critical events
individual courage/fear/values only when explicitly sourced for this NPC
decision occurs at the semantic boundary
break_contact_basis: NPC's intent to create distance or leave combat
only exits/paths known to NPC and included in operation contract
code-owned route, obstruction, movement capability and progress check
surrender_or_exit_facts.physical_effect: intent alone never commits a successful escape or changes another participant's reaction
prohibited_shortcuts: invented exit/destination or model-asserted movement success

body_state_qualitative_context.purpose: translate an authoritative current NPC body metric into one qualitative phrase for decision context; this context alone does not select an action

input_policy.eligible_value: current authoritative body-state owner readback for this NPC
input_policy.unavailable_or_unreadable: omit that metric and preserve a typed gap; never substitute zero or a candidate initialization value
input_policy.unapproved_initialization: do not consume the unapproved D71 initial-body proposal as an authoritative value
